questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a function of mesosomes?
questions.option_1: Increase the surface area of the plasma membrane and enzymatic content
questions.option_2: DNA replication and distribution to daughter cells
questions.solution:
Locomotion is NOT a function of mesosomes.
  • Mesosomes are extensions of the plasma membrane in bacteria.
  • They function in respiration, DNA replication, distribution of chromosomes to daughter cells, and increasing the surface area for enzymatic activity.
  • Locomotion in bacteria is primarily achieved via flagella.

questions.question: Several biological processes are catalysed by enzymes. Digestive enzymes are present in which part of the cell?
questions.solution:
Lysosomes contain digestive (hydrolytic) enzymes.
  • They are known as the 'suicidal bags' of the cell because they break down waste materials, cellular debris, and foreign particles.
  • These enzymes work best in the acidic environment found inside the lysosome.

questions.question: What is the name of the process of organic matter being broken down into simpler compounds by decomposers?
questions.solution:
The process of breaking down organic matter into simpler compounds is called Decomposition.
  • Decomposers like bacteria and fungi play a vital role in recycling nutrients back into the ecosystem by breaking down dead plants and animals.

questions.question: The Krebs cycle of aerobic respiration is carried out within which of the following cell organelles?
questions.solution:
The Krebs cycle (Citric Acid Cycle) occurs within the Mitochondria.
  • This cycle is a key part of aerobic respiration, where acetyl-CoA is oxidized to produce energy in the form of ATP, $NADH$, and $FADH_2$.

questions.question: A person with a very low count of red blood cells is medically known to have _______.
questions.solution:
A very low count of red blood cells or hemoglobin is medically known as Anaemia.
  • This condition reduces the blood's ability to carry oxygen to the body's tissues, often leading to fatigue and weakness.

questions.question: What is the term for the maximum population size that an environment can sustain indefinitely?
questions.solution:
Carrying capacity is the maximum population size of a species that a specific environment can support indefinitely.
  • It is determined by available resources like food, water, habitat, and other necessities.

questions.question: Which of the following possesses the largest isolated single cell?
questions.solution:
The Ostrich egg is considered the largest isolated single cell currently known.
  • While most cells are microscopic, the yolk of an unfertilized ostrich egg is a single, massive cell.

questions.question: What is the primary function of the excretory system in animals?
questions.solution:
The primary function of the excretory system is the removal of nitrogenous waste products from the body.
  • In humans, this system includes the kidneys, ureters, urinary bladder, and urethra, which filter blood and produce urine.

questions.question: What is the specific field of study focused on examining extinct animals?
questions.solution: Palaeontology is the scientific study of life that existed prior to the start of the Holocene epoch, primarily through the examination of fossils of extinct animals and plants.

questions.question: Which of the following statements about phylum Arthropoda are correct? Animals of Arthropoda have joint appendages. They have compounds eyes. These make up the majority of all animals on earth. The mode of reproduction in all Arthropods is vegetative.
questions.solution:
Statements A, B, and C are correct regarding Phylum Arthropoda.
  • Arthropods have jointed appendages (A) and compound eyes (B).
  • They constitute the largest phylum, representing the majority of all animals on Earth (C).
  • Correction: Statement D is incorrect; arthropods primarily reproduce sexually, not vegetatively.

questions.question: A child is a picky eater. He does not consume milk at all and barely eats other kinds of food. When he started losing his baby teeth, they were not getting replaced with new teeth. This can be solved by giving him ___________.
questions.solution:
The child’s dental issues can be addressed with calcium supplements.
  • Calcium, often found in milk, is essential for the development and maintenance of strong teeth and bones. A lack of it in a growing child can lead to poor tooth development.

questions.question: If the body of an animal can be divided into two indistinguishable left and right halves through only one plane, then it possesses:
questions.solution:
When a body can be divided into identical left and right halves through only one plane, it exhibits bilateral symmetry. [Image showing bilateral symmetry in an animal like a butterfly or beetle]
  • Examples include humans, insects, and most vertebrates.

questions.question: The percentage of sunlight energy absorbed by the green plants in a terrestrial ecosystem is about _______.
questions.solution:
In a terrestrial ecosystem, green plants capture only about 1% of the energy of sunlight that falls on their leaves.
  • This small fraction of solar energy is converted into chemical energy through photosynthesis.

questions.question: Which of the following communicable diseases is caused by bacteria?
questions.solution:
Cholera is a communicable disease caused by the bacterium Vibrio cholerae.
  • Influenza and Dengue are viral, while Malaria is caused by a protozoan parasite (Plasmodium).

questions.question: All living organisms on the Earth are made up of carbon compounds. Many years ago, dead and buried plants started slowly modifying into coal under high temperature and high pressure. This process is called:
questions.solution:
The slow conversion of dead vegetation into coal under high pressure and temperature is called carbonization.
  • Over millions of years, the high carbon content of the plant matter is preserved while volatile components are removed.

questions.question:
Which of the following statements about pteridophytes are correct?

Statements: They include horsetails and ferns. Pteridophytes are used for medicinal purposes and as soil-binders. They are very advanced type of plants on earth, which evolved very recently. Evolutionarily, they are the first terrestrial plants to possess vascular tissues - xylem and phloem.
questions.solution:
Statements A, B, and D are correct regarding Pteridophytes.
  • They include horsetails and ferns (A) and are used as soil-binders and medicine (B).
  • They were the first terrestrial plants to evolve vascular tissues (xylem and phloem) (D).
  • Correction: They are not 'recently evolved' advanced plants; that description fits Angiosperms (flowering plants).

questions.question: Excessive bleeding from wounds may happen due to lack of ____.
questions.solution:
Excessive bleeding is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin K.
  • Vitamin K is essential for the synthesis of proteins required for blood clotting (coagulation).

questions.question: The process by which a water body gradually becomes enriched with nutrients and minerals, mainly phosphorus and nitrogen, leading to enormous growth of algae on the surface of the water, thus decreasing the amount of dissolved oxygen in the water is known as:
questions.solution:
The enrichment of a water body with nutrients leading to algal blooms and oxygen depletion is called Eutrophication.
  • This process often results in 'dead zones' where aquatic life cannot survive due to a lack of oxygen (hypoxia).

questions.question: Which of the following groups of plants are categorised as cryptogams?
questions.solution:
Bryophytes and Thallophyta are categorized as Cryptogams.
  • Cryptogams are plants that reproduce by spores and do not produce flowers or seeds ('hidden reproduction').

questions.question: Which of the following are building blocks of proteins?
questions.solution:
Amino acids are the building blocks of proteins.
  • There are 20 standard amino acids that combine in various sequences to form the diverse proteins found in living organisms.

questions.question: On boiling an egg, why does the outer part become opaque and white?
questions.option_1: The heat causes a change in the crystal structure of egg yolk.
questions.option_2: The heat causes denaturation, hardening the albumin and colouring it opaque white
questions.option_3: The heat causes a change in the structure of egg protein.
questions.option_4: The heat causes a reaction of the egg with water and makes it opaque.
questions.solution:
The white, opaque appearance of a boiled egg is due to protein denaturation.
  • Heat causes the clear, liquid protein (albumin) to uncoil and clump together, turning it into a solid, opaque mass.

questions.question:
Which of the following options correctly matches column-A and column-B?

Column-A (Food component) Column-B (Enzyme involved in digestion)

i. Protein a. Amylase

ii. Carbohydrates b. Lipase

iii. Fats c. Trypsin
questions.solution:
The correct matches for food components and their digestive enzymes are:
  • i-c: Proteins are broken down by Trypsin.
  • ii-a: Carbohydrates are broken down by Amylase.
  • iii-b: Fats are broken down by Lipase.

questions.question: A person having stunted growth and discoloured hair is most probably suffering from ________________.
questions.solution:
Stunted growth and discolored hair are symptoms of Protein Deficiency (specifically conditions like Kwashiorkor).
  • Protein is vital for growth, tissue repair, and the production of pigments like melanin in the hair.

questions.question: Which of the following statements is NOT true about Plastids?
questions.option_3: Starch, oils and protein granules are stored in chromoplasts.
questions.solution:
The statement that 'Starch, oils and protein granules are stored in chromoplasts' is NOT true.
  • These substances are stored in Leucoplasts (specifically amyloplasts, elaioplasts, and aleuroplasts).
  • Chromoplasts contain pigments like carotene and xanthophylls, giving colors to flowers and fruits.

questions.question: To get relief from constipation, which of the following is prescribed to be eaten in large amount?
questions.solution:
To relieve constipation, a diet high in fibre is prescribed.
  • Dietary fibre adds bulk to the stool and helps it pass more easily through the digestive system.
